title: Member check source
description: Woodcore-Datei/checks/<id>.json -- one member check (vérification d'élément), written by Woodcore and read by calc/domains/member_check.py alone (docs/domain/connectors.md §3.3nonies, docs/domain/member-checks.md §3.3undecies). Nothing is computed from it in Python: the export resolves what it follows (the position's strength class, section and moisture class) and lib/timber.typ's #show-check-member computes the check. The kinds `tension` (SIA 265 4.2.1), `compression` (4.2.2), `bending` (4.2.3, 4.2.4, the section alone), `shear` (4.2.5), `buckling` (4.2.8) and `lateral-torsional` (4.2.9) are implemented; a compression at an angle to the grain also states its contact -- `case`, `larger`, `l`, `w` -- which the other kinds ignore, and a bending its moments `M_y`, `M_z`, which the other kinds ignore.

schema_version.description: -- accepted: 1.0; 1.1, the same with `links`, which Woodcore writes only where a field follows a variable; 1.2, the same with `fire` (and `links` or not), which Woodcore writes only for a check in the fire situation (issue #46).

id.description: The file name without .json, and the string the report addresses the check by: letters, digits and _ . + -.

group.description: Optional: the folder of Woodcore's list, "" for the root (additive, docs/decisions.md §13 v0.69).

kind.description: The kind of check; tension, compression, bending, shear, buckling and lateral-torsional are implemented, any other is refused as not implemented yet.

position.description: The position the member is, whose values the nulls below follow; null for a member that is no position.

grade.description: A strength class of SIA 265 Tabelle 8 or 9; null follows the position's.

section.description: The section, in mm: {"type": "rec", "b": 100, "h": 200} or {"type": "cir", "d": 200}; null follows the position's.

moisture_class.description: 1, 2 or 3 (SIA 265 Tabelle 3); null follows the position's.

alpha.description: The angle between the force and the grain, in degrees, 0 to 90. A compression at 0 is the section alone (4.2.2.1, no buckling); above 0 a contact, (11) at 90 and (12), (13) between. A bending at 0 is (14), (21) or (22); above 0 it reads M_y alone, (15)/(16) at 90 and (17) to (20) between, with a normal force (21) or (22) at that angle. A shear, a buckling and a lateral torsional buckling are along the grain, alpha 0 (issue #38).

N.description: The design force: a tension's normal force, positive; a compression's magnitude, positive -- along the grain the normal force over the whole section, at an angle the force F on the contact area; a bending's normal force SIGNED, tension positive, compression negative, 0 for none. Every kind but a shear states it; a buckling's is its magnitude, positive, a lateral torsional buckling's signed (issue #38).

case.description: A compression at an angle: which f_c,90,d of SIA 265 Tabelle 8 or 9 is read -- "generell", "mit_vorholz" (at least 100 mm of timber beyond the load on both sides) or "endauflagerung". Optional; absent or null is generell.

larger.description: A compression at an angle: true reads the bracketed f_c,90,d (Tabelle 8 note 4, Tabelle 9 note 3), the larger indentations provably without influence on the load-bearing member -- with mit_vorholz or endauflagerung only. Optional; absent or null is false.

l.description: A compression at an angle: the contact length along the grain, in mm, above 0 -- required there; ignored otherwise.

w.description: A compression at an angle: the contact width, in mm, above 0; null follows the section's width b (a round section has none to follow).

M_y.description: A bending: the design moment about y (in the plane of h), its sign immaterial; absent, null or 0 is none. Optional, additive (v0.117).

M_z.description: A bending: the design moment about z, along the grain only (alpha 0); absent, null or 0 is none. Optional, additive (v0.117).

V_z.description: A shear: the design shear force in the plane of h (z), its sign immaterial; absent, null or 0 is none. Optional, additive (issue #38).

V_y.description: A shear: the design shear force in the plane of b (y), likewise. Optional, additive (issue #38).

pith.description: A shear: a member cut from the pith takes half of f_v,d (SIA 265 Tabelle 8 note 6). Optional; absent or null is false (issue #38).

variant.description: A shear check: what it checks -- `shear` (SIA 265 4.2.5.1, the default), `shear-off` (4.2.6, F on l and w), `shear-perp` (4.2.7.1, V_z with sigma_90) -- chosen in the «Effort tranchant» tab's list (spec 2026-10-21-commandes-typst-refonte, REQ-021). Optional; absent or null is shear.

F.description: A shear-off: the design force sheared off, a {value, unit} block (4.2.6). l and w are its sheared length and width, w null following the member's width.

sigma_90.description: A shear with a stress perpendicular to the grain: that design stress in N/mm², transverse tension positive (4.2.7.1).

l_y.description: A buckling, or a lateral torsional buckling with a compression: the system length about y, in mm, 0 or above -- the buckling length is beta_y · l_y, 0 holding the member against buckling about y. Optional, additive (issue #38).

beta_y.description: The buckling length coefficient about y, 0 or above: 1 pinned-pinned, 2 cantilever, 0.7, 0.5; absent or null is 1 (issue #38).

a.description: A lateral torsional buckling: the distance between the lateral supports, in mm, above 0 -- sigma_m,crit by (41); or null with sigma_m_crit given (issue #38).

sigma_m_crit.description: A lateral torsional buckling: the critical bending stress of a finer calculation, in N/mm², above 0, in place of (41) -- never with a (issue #38).

fire.description: The design situation fire, SIA 265 4.5.2 (issue #46): present, the check is one of the fire-resistance tab and is computed on the ideal residual section with R_d,fi = 1.8 · R_d, its forces being E_d,fi. Only for tension, compression, bending, shear and buckling, along the grain. Additive, at schema_version 1.2; absent for a check at normal temperature.

duration.description: The fire resistance checked, in minutes, written over; null follows what VKF / AEAI 15-15 requires for the project's building (Woodcore-Datei/building.json) and the check's `top_level`.

sides.description: The faces of the rectangle the fire reaches, each true or false: left and right reduce b, bottom and top h (SIA 265 Figur 13).

wood.description: The row of SIA 265 Tabelle 13: null for a softwood grade, beech or oak for a hardwood one (D30), cladding for solid timber cladding.

top_level.description: The member is on the top storey: VKF 15-15 notes [1] and [8]. Optional, false.

links.description: The fields that follow a variable of the export, by their key in this file (N, V_z, V_y, M_y, M_z, alpha, section.b, section.h, section.d, l, w, l_y, l_z, a, beta_y, beta_z, sigma_m_crit): the number the field holds beside it is the last value known, which a variable that can no longer be read leaves in place with a warning (D-06). Absent where no field follows one; present at schema_version 1.1 and 1.2.

.*.description: A variable of the export this field follows (calc/domains/links.py, spec 2026-10-11-variables-liees-champs-et-textes D-17): the pair a call names its calculation by and its key -- a domain of the «Formule» tab carries origin "formulas" and its id as instance --, with an optional factor and offset (factor × variable + offset).
